violation_type.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants-Hold through 6-months (26 TAC §746.2419(1))
violation_type.typical_finding: A caregiver was observed feeding two babies under 6 months at once. One laying across her lap and the other on the floor.

finding_variants.text: A caregiver was observed feeding two babies under 6 months at once. One laying across her lap and the other on the floor.
A 2 month old infant was being fed by caregiver while child was laying on a bouncer seat.       NOTE: This was corrected after caregiver was informed. Caregiver held child to be fed.
A four month old was laying on a bobby pillow being fed by staff and not being held.
An infant in care was allowed to drink from a bottle while in a bouncer.
During the DFPS investigation it was determined that instead of holding the 4 month old child, staff propped their bottle.
A caregiver was observed feeding a 3 month old while the infant was laying propped up on a pillow. This was correct during the inspection with the caregiver picking the infant up to feed them.
